review:
Marlin Masters: The Big Haul is a 5-reel, 4-row fishing slot with both paylines and LootLine wins, following Big Bob and his boat Bettsy the Beaut as he chases a marlin. Hacksaw lists a 10,000x max win on the game page.

The theme is relaxed beach fishing, but the mechanics lean on collecting values across the grid in the bonus, as in most Hacksaw fishing games. Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP or volatility for this title outside the game, so open the info screen in the demo to see them. It suits fans of Big Bass-style fishing slots who want Hacksaw's take on the theme.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
